notes.title: 1.03 Update description
notes.notes:
UI correlation

- Fixed an issue where the scroll wheel on the backpack interface could not slide

- Adjusted the control function of ESC cases, so that ESC can close the map and other UI

Fixed an issue where two options would light up at the same time during a conversation



Data correlation

Fixed a BUG where the tavern's debit time was advanced

Fixed a BUG where the island debit time was advanced

Fixed display issues with mining games

Added daily revenue tips for pubs



Scene correlation

Adjusted the problem of home decoration

Adjusted the cameras inside the home

Adjusted the size of the interior rooms of the home



New content

Added a treasure chest that refreshes every 15 minutes on the home island and gets the right amount of items each time you open it
